title: Writing Task 1 - Line Graph: Internet Usage Comparison
description: IELTS Writing Task 1: Describe a line graph comparing internet usage rates in developed vs developing nations.

stimuli.title: Task 1: Internet Usage Rates — Developed vs Developing Countries (2000–2020)
stimuli.content:
You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

The line graph below shows the percentage of the population using the internet in developed and developing countries between 2000 and 2020.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

Data: Developed countries: 30% (2000), 51% (2005), 68% (2010), 80% (2015), 87% (2020). Developing countries: 4% (2000), 9% (2005), 23% (2010), 41% (2015), 60% (2020).

questionGroups.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

questions.content: Describe the line graph comparing internet usage in developed and developing countries from 2000 to 2020.

keyFeatures: Developed countries had a significant head start with 30% usage in 2000 vs just 4% in developing nations
Developing countries showed a steeper rate of growth, especially after 2005
The gap between the two groups narrowed from 26 percentage points in 2000 to 27 points in 2020
By 2020, developing countries reached 60%, a level developed countries surpassed around 2008
